Description:
The hotel is located in the new area of Xicheng, about an 8-minute drive from the centre of Guilin. The airport is about a 20-minute drive from the hotel.

Fully renovated in 2010, there are 115 rooms in total at this city hotel. Guests are welcomed in the lobby with 24-hour reception and check-out services, a hotel safe, cloakroom and lift access to the upper floors. For those travelling to the city on business, variously-sized multifunctional meeting halls and the hotel's business centre are available. Guests can also dine in the restaurant. Wireless Internet access, and room and laundry services are available. A large car park is also available (for a fee).

A range of elegantly decorated rooms are on offer at this hotel. All rooms are fitted with central air conditioning and heating, Internet access, a satellite TV and an international direct dial phone. They are en suite with a shower, bath and a hairdryer. Further in-room amenities include a double bed and a minibar.

The hotel provides a sauna, steam room, massages and a gym. There is also an entertainment programme for adults.

The on-site Chinese restaurant seats up to 300 people, but diners and event planners can also make use of the hotel's 13 banquet halls, which serve both fine Cantonese and Xiang dishes as well as various snacks. Guests can select breakfast from a buffet each morning. Lunch and dinner are available à la carte, from a set menu and in buffet form.
